serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I’m back.
You: Here you go, your slushie.
Bot: Thanks!
You: Did you pick a song when I was getting your slushie? 
Bot: No, I wanted you to show me first what this is all about.
You: Alright, sure, but I need to warn you, I’m not really a very good singer.
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: It’s ok, I will not laugh. I can even shut off my face actuators manually if you want. 
You: No, I don't think that's necessary…
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
Hmmm…{{wi}} What song should I choose? 
I’m not an audiophile and I don’t know that many songs…
Let’s just hit random and see what we get.
The title doesn’t tell me anything.
Whatever, it’s my first song after a long time so I shouldn't sweat it so much.
You: Alright, here I go.
